deviations.when: after the first fork run (S5 ValueError) and the first upstream run (pi0_fast_libero S1 OSError); outputs of both first runs were replaced by re-runs of this version

reason.D3: harness bug: the fork's RunningStats.update accepts only 2-D batches; both compute_norm_stats scripts pass values.reshape(-1, values.shape[-1]); the probe now does the same (upstream's update reshapes internally, so its numbers are unaffected)
reason.D4: FAST configs build the FAST tokenizer from the Hub inside DataConfigFactory.create; offline isolation blocks it (OSError). The probe now falls back to create_base_config, the function that sets use_quantile_norm (source pins openpi.quantile_selection, fork.base_config_no_quantile), and labels the record selection_scope. It refuses the fallback for the fork's SimpleDataConfig, whose flag is set outside create_base_config. Normalization for those configs applies their flag to the stats_config's arrays (S6_note).
reason.D5: the frozen VLABench org-scan rule selected VLABench/pi0-fast-ft-primitive-10task-deltachunk (ft asset) and VLABench/pi0-fast-primitive-deltachunk-w-two-bridge (pretrain asset), which the frozen per-case list omitted. The rule is authoritative: the probe adds scan-selected checkpoints missing from the list, mapped by the frozen mechanical rule (common.vlabench_candidates + unanimous use_quantile_norm), tagged added_by_deviation.

deviations.when: after the fork re-run showed S8 broadcast errors for 7-dim FAST checkpoint stats against 32-dim PI0-pipeline arrays
deviations.reason: new script, not preregistered: reruns S8 for FAST-mapped VLABench checkpoints on the first 7 dims of the PI0-pipeline arrays, which equal the FAST pipeline's arrays (fork VLABenchInputs pad_to_dim is a no-op at action_dim 7; DeltaActions acts on the first dims). The S8 errors in openpi_fork.json are kept and labelled harness shape artifacts.
